units.source_text: 脱长裤时，一把沙子通过手指的根部，直冲泻到了大腿的内侧……

en.t: As he took off his trousers, a handful of sand passed through the base of his fingers and poured straight down onto the inside of his thigh...

units.source_text: 像焖透了的袜子，气味蒸腾而上……

en.t: Like socks soaked through with heat and sweat, the smell steamed upward...

units.source_text: 慢慢的，但却是确凿的充实，发出了即将断水的自来水管声响，再次充满了他的下体……

en.t: Slowly, but with unmistakable fullness, making the sound of a water pipe about to run dry, it filled his lower body again...

units.source_text: 没有帽子的下体标明方向……

en.t: His uncovered lower body marked out the direction...

units.source_text: 他展开翅膀，在已经赤裸的女人身后融化了。

en.t: He spread his wings and melted behind the woman, who was already naked.
